The '''MK.II "Steelskin" Anti-concussive armor''' was a model of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] produced by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 6,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was one of the heaviest non-powered personal armor and was illegal on most worlds.<ref name="DC" />
